@graph.name: Dermato Surgery
@graph.description: Dermato surgery in Marathahalli, Whitefield, Bangalore. Minimally invasive removal of moles, cysts, warts and skin tags, plus acne scar revision and vitiligo surgery. Book a consultation.
@graph.howPerformed: The technique is chosen for each concern and may involve radiofrequency, laser or surgical excision. Many minor procedures are done under local anaesthesia, and your dermatologist explains wound care and follow-up visits in detail. Moles that look unusual or have changed are assessed carefully before the right treatment approach is decided.

mainEntity.name: What conditions can dermato surgery treat?

acceptedAnswer.text: It treats skin growths like moles, cysts, warts and skin tags, as well as acne scars and stable vitiligo patches. It also covers hair loss, through hair restoration procedures.
Most minor procedures are done under local anaesthesia, so discomfort is minimal. Any mild tenderness afterwards is usually easy to manage.

mainEntity.name: Will there be a scar after mole or cyst removal?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your dermatologist chooses the technique best suited to the growth, to keep any mark as small as possible. Healing varies from person to person.
It depends on the procedure. Many minor procedures need only simple wound care, and your dermatologist explains aftercare and follow-up during the consultation.
